question: Etruscans taught the early Romans:
solution:
The correct answer is **'****The skills of trade'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage talks about all the myths and legends associated with the founding of Rome. 
 
• In the last paragraph of the passage, it has been stated - *'**The Etruscans, to the north, provided a model for trade and urban luxury.* *' *
 
• Thus, we can conclude that the Etruscans taught the early Romans "**the skills of trade."**
 
• This makes option 4 the correct answer.
